description: Java NIO buffers. On Xbox 360 these resolve to the hand-written NIOBuffers platform layer (a typed view over a heap allocation); the rows below are the contract that layer must satisfy.

cpp.note: Must exist on the NIOBuffers base Buffer; every typed buffer inherits it.
Base Buffer method; used before handing a buffer to a draw/put call.

Buffer.limit.doc: Set the limit; 0-arg getter returns it.

cpp.note: Needs BOTH overloads: limit() getter and limit(int) setter.

FloatBuffer.put.doc: Append a float, put-at-index, or bulk-put an array.

cpp.note: Needs put(float), put(int,float) absolute, and put(JArray<float>) bulk overloads.

IntBuffer.put.doc: Append an int, put-at-index, or bulk-put an array.

cpp.note: Needs put(int), put(int,int) absolute, and put(JArray<int>) bulk overloads.
Allocate a heap-backed FloatBuffer of the given capacity.
Return a real malloc-backed ByteBuffer (NULL here NULL-crashes screenshots).
